name: forge-shapes
description: File checks over a monoforge-stamped tree: the receipt ships and parses, every file the receipt claims exists, the truth-slot law holds (no FORGE-TODO, no raw __TOKEN__ survives), the package.json bin/exports/files entries all resolve, the publish workflow refuses 0.x refs and carries no publish token, and the docs gates the tree ships actually pass. Pure reads over a tree - zero network, zero writes.
